risks.risk: The motor may be burnt out or have a weak battery.
risks.proof: A video showing the hair dryer plugged in and successfully drying a hair sample.

risks.risk: The internal heating element may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the hair dryer heating up and producing a visible steam or heat haze.

risks.risk: The internal fan may be noisy or have a broken impeller.
risks.proof: A video showing the hair dryer running at all speed settings.

risks.risk: The stand may be unstable or have a broken hinge.
risks.proof: A video showing the stand being adjusted and the hair dryer being moved around.

Video of the hair dryer plugged in and drying a piece of hair.

response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
